sourceDesc.p: A synthetic test document. It is not a scholarly edition of a historical source.

projectDesc.p: This document makes the processing cascade inspectable. The edition ODD controls its two custom elements; ordinary TEI elements fall through to conservative TEI All class contracts.

body.head: Three decisions, with their provenance
body.p: This paragraph is ordinary TEI. Its paragraph behaviour comes from the TEI All fallback contract, not from a rule in this edition’s ODD.
At autosave 17, the born-digital writing environment recorded a save event. This italic, bold treatment is explicitly declared by the edition ODD.
The event was produced by Torchio. The ODD’s web processing model turns the declared reference into a link.
Undated save event has no @when: the first ODD predicate does not match, so the second ODD model renders it as a block. No element-name switch is involved.
